x_note: Worked example from ADR-0018/the Stage 111 brief: this proposal ('B') was created expecting the active revision to still be 1 (expected_active_dmap_revision=1), but by the time it is submitted for acceptance, a DIFFERENT proposal ('A', not shown -- see dserver::core::ddeploy's two_proposals_same_active_revision_first_succeeds_second_is_stale for the full Rust state-machine proof) has already been accepted and moved the active revision to 2 (x_current_active_dmap_revision_at_accept_time). accept_proposal's compare-and-swap check (expected_active_dmap_revision != current_active_revision) must reject this with F_STALE_ACTIVE_DMAP_REVISION (HTTP 409) rather than silently activating as revision 3.
